proposed_rules.trigger: An identical ~453px band at the very bottom of the page reading 'The best no-code platform for...' plus a small social-icon row, recurring unchanged across unrelated templates (download, integration, ebook-category).
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a site-wide footer fragment rendered on every page, not as per-page authored content. Alternative rejected: treating it as a normal page-ending CTA section authored per page (rejected because content and layout are byte-identical across templates, indicating global chrome rather than page content).
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text/size across independently themed templates strongly indicates a shared footer/fragment injected site-wide rather than page-authored content.

provenance.evidence: C89 rc2 identical to same node in C84-C87

proposed_rules.trigger: Multiple mid-page rows/pairs on an 'integration-2' template capture with no quoted text (rc1c2c2c1/c2, rc1c2c6, rc1c2c8) despite visible box structure, unlike the surrounding rows which do carry text.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag these rows for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction rather than treating them as empty; they likely hold icon-labeled trigger/action pairs or accordion Q/A text that fell below the minWidth capture threshold.
proposed_rules.rationale: Structurally identical siblings elsewhere on the same page do carry text, so the blank rows are a capture gap, not real emptiness.

provenance.evidence: C89 rc1c2c2c1, rc1c2c2c2, rc1c2c6, rc1c2c8 have box geometry but no text
